plan.title: Cedar Chapel Choir Evening

drafts.invitation:
Dear Members of the Congregation,

Subject: Invitation to the Cedar Chapel Choir Evening

River Parish cordially invites you to attend the Cedar Chapel Choir Evening, a special musical event led by Musa Bello. The purpose of this evening is to enjoy a dedicated performance by the choir in a spirit of fellowship.

The event will take place on Saturday, 13 February 2027, at Grace Chapel. Registration will commence at 17:45, with the formal programme beginning at 18:00.

Please note that permission for outdoor seating is currently pending approval from the Minister. We will provide updates regarding this as soon as possible.

We look forward to welcoming you to this evening of music.

Yours faithfully,

Ruth Alabi
Secretary
